title: townie-survival
body:
Hey everyone,

If you're tired of massive network servers with 50 different lobbies and bloated features, we're running a straightforward, community-focused survival server. We wanted to build something that keeps the core vanilla survival feel but adds the right quality-of-life plugins to make playing together a lot better.

A quick look at what we have:

Java & Bedrock Crossplay: Play from your PC, phone, or console seamlessly.

Player-Driven Economy: Earn money with the Job system, sell your extra resources via the GUI shop, or trade with others on the Auction House.

Toggleable PvP: Play at your own pace. Turn PvP on if you want some action, or keep it off if you just want to relax and build in peace.

QoL Features: SimpleRTP to get you out into the wild instantly, LockIt to secure your chests, and Timber so chopping down a tree doesn't take all day.

Fair Play: We use GrimAC to keep things completely cheat-free, alongside standard safe zones and spawn protection.

We also have Discord integration so you can chat with players in-game even when you're offline.

How to join:

Java IP: Townie-survival.playwn.co

Bedrock IP: Townie-survival.playwn.co

Bedrock Port: 19146

Come drop in and say hi!
